show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/7Wt6kz
show.description:
Kabir Malhotra, ek ameer aur razdaar businessman, apni beeti hui mohabbat ko dhoond raha hai. Ananya Raizada, ek single mother, jiske past par sawal bhi hain aur taqat bhi. Ek galat blind date unhe takraata hai — aur shuru hoti hai ek kahaani, jahan beizzati, taane, aur jadui taqaton ke beech pyaar fir se jeetne ki koshish karta hai.
“Beauty That Bleeds” ek aisi kahani hai jahan zakhm bhi hai, chamatkar bhi — aur mohabbat, sabse gehre dard ke beech palti hai.
